newsitem.title: USA: Clinton invites budget leaders to White House.
newsitem.headline: Clinton invites budget leaders to White House.

text.p: President Clinton invited House and Senate Budget Committee leaders to a White House meeting Wednesday, congressional sources said Tuesday.

The meeting will take place against the backdrop of suggestions by some top Republicans that tax cuts be postponed until the budget is balanced, a view welcomed by the administration as progress towards reaching a five-year balanced budget deal.
However, Republicans found significant resistance to the suggestion within their own ranks, chiefly from a group of conservatives who warned a delay would doom the tax cut.
